text:
Kai: Morning — quick headroom check for EMEA GPU pools. Planning a small canary rollout (model v2.3) at 10:30 CET, would like AMS1 -> AMS2 flip if headroom allows. Anyone seeing current pressure?

Sharon: AMS1 is at ~78% alloc right now, AMS2 sits at ~42%. Spot eviction chatter in AMS1 last hour (see eviction spikes). If we push more traffic to AMS1 it's tight.

Mike: Noted. Where are you reading those numbers from? Link or metric query?

Sharon: Use the headroom endpoint: `curl -s http://metrics.internal/ams1/headroom | jq .` — returns `{\"gpu_headroom_pct\":22}`. Also Grafana dashboard -> Fleet / EMEA / AMS1 shows the spikes.

Kai: Okay, so AMS1 headroom ~22% which is borderline for the canary. Can we prewarm a couple nodes in AMS2 and route 20% of canary there?

Tara: I can prewarm 4 nodes in AMS2 (will add a TAINT_SOAK label for canary). Quick note: prewarm takes ~6-8 mins with kv-cache warmup for our Llama variants.

Grant: I queued a small reservation: `reservationctl create --region=ams2 --count=4 --ttl=30m --tags=canary` — gave reservation id CR-4921.

Kai: Nice — @Grant can you attach the reservation id to the rollout PR? We'll need the reservation in case autoscaler delays.

Grant: Yep — added CR-4921 in PR description and in the canary playbook.

Mike: One quick ask: AMS1 eviction noise — can someone look at spot fallback policy for that AZ? If nodes get preempted we'll want an immediate fallback to on-demand lane, not queue. Ticketed as INFRA-1872 (I can follow up).

Sharon: INFRA-1872 ack. I ran a quick `kubectl describe nodes -l spot=true -n gpu-pool | grep -E "Taint|Preemption"` and saw two nodes with preemption recent events. I'll add a temporary nodeSelector to avoid those for the canary.

Tara: For rollout gating — suggest: (1) start canary with 10% traffic split across AMS2 reservation + remaining in AMS1, (2) watch p50/p95 latency and token cost for 10m, (3) if headroom dips below 15% halt and autoscale +1 on-demand.

Kai: Sounds good. @ops-bot can you post an autoscaler override if headroom < 15% and tag the canary with CR-4921?

ops-bot: Autoscaler policy check scheduled. I will monitor `gpu_headroom_pct` for AMS1 and AMS2. If any region reports <15% for a 3-min rolling window, I'll trigger `autoscaler override --mode=on-demand --reason="canary-safety-CR-4921"` and notify #eng-infra.

Grant: I also pushed a small readiness tweak to the canary image so cold-start latency is reduced by ~200ms (warmup of kv cache earlier). PR link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/canaries/pulls/248 — added notes re: CR-4921 and INFRA-1872.

Mike: I'll keep an eye on the logs. If we see increased 429s from the model lane, I'll flip the traffic back and escalate.

Sharon: Quick sanity check command for whoever runs the rollout: `curl -s http://metrics.internal/ams1/alloc | jq . | {used,capacity}` — confirms alloc before pushing traffic.

Kai: Plan: Tara prewarms AMS2 now, Grant holds reservation, Mike watches logs, Sharon monitors spot signals, I will start the canary at 10:30 CET with 10% traffic. If all green after 15m, increment to 30%.

Tara: Prewarm kicked off (ETA ~7m). Will post when nodes ready. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Prewarm job started for reservation CR-4921. Nodes will be labeled `canary=true, taint=canary-soak` upon ready. ETA approx 7m.

Kai: Thanks all. If anything blips, tag me and I'll pause the rollout.

Tara: Nodes ready — AMS2 reservation CR-4921 shows 4 nodes ready and labeled.

ops-bot: Autoscaler monitor: AMS1 gpu_headroom_pct=22 -> 18 (rolling 5m). AMS2 gpu_headroom_pct=60. No override triggered (threshold 15%).

Grant: Kicking the rollout now (10:31 CET) with traffic split 10% across AMS2 reservation + remaining in AMS1.

Mike: Seeing initial traffic. p50 latency unchanged, p95 +120ms (expected). No 429s. Monitoring.

Sharon: Spot signals calming. Will update if anything changes.

ops-bot: Rollout event logged: rollout-id r-2026-03-17-430123. Tags: CR-4921, canary, INFRA-1872. If anyone needs the rollout log: https://logs.internal/rollouts/r-2026-03-17-430123

Kai: Great. Will check back in 15m. :eyes:
